Bogotá is the capital and largest city in Colombia. A melting pot of people from around the country and this weekend the home of the latest Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series. Players from as far as Panama and the United States of America have come to Duel to be the newest YCS champion. 246 Duelist have pre-registered for this weekends event and battle for the title of King of Games. Check back here for updates and coverage of YCS Bogotá!

We are in Bogotá, the vibrant capital of Colombia, cradled in the chilly Andean peaks and steeped in sophisticated urban cool. Day 1 of YCS Bogotá is about to start and there are many notable Duelist here with eyes on winning the YCS. Registered for this weekend’s event is Jarel Winston from NY, USA. Jarel took his Exodia Deck all the way to a Top 8 finish at the 2012 World Championship.
